map.如何使用纸牌接龙？: How do I use Klondike Solitaire?
map.纸牌接龙适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Klondike Solitaire best for?
map.经典 Klondike 接龙 - 将所有牌按花色从 A 到 K 移至基础堆: Classic Klondike Solitaire - move all cards by suit from A to K onto the foundations
map.将 52 张牌按红黑交替、点数递减叠列，从 A 到 K 按花色移入基础堆；翻牌堆: Stack the 52 cards alternating red/black and decreasing in rank, moving A-to-K by suit onto the foundations; the stock and waste piles help scheduling, and all home means a win.
map.开局翻出 7 列共 28 张、翻牌堆 24 张；先把可移的 红6→黑7 理顺，优: Deal 7 columns of 28 cards and a stock of 24; first tidy movable red-6 to black-7, prioritize flipping empty columns for K; move A♠A♥A♣A♦ to foundations and collect 4 A-K sets to win. Pure frontend, no network.
map.视实现支持；基础版可重置重开，进阶版加单步撤销。: Depends on the build; the basic version can reset, the advanced adds single-step undo.
map.随机发牌未必可解，属概率游戏；可重开换局面。: A random deal is not always solvable; it is a probabilistic game—restart for a new layout.
map.将52张牌全部移至4个基础堆，按花色从A到K依次排列。: Move all 52 cards to the 4 foundations, ordered by suit from A to K.
map.：翻一张牌到废牌堆，牌库用完后点击可重新翻: : flip one card to the waste; once the stock is empty, click to recycle it
map.：将牌拖到合法位置。桌面列间红黑交替降序排列: : drag a card to a legal spot. Tableau columns alternate red/black in descending order
map.：自动将牌移到基础堆: : auto-move the card to the foundation
map.：点击选中牌，再点击目标位置移动: : tap to select a card, then tap the target to move
map.桌面列（Tableau）：红黑交替、从 K 到 A 降序排列: Tableau: alternate red/black, descending from K to A
map.空列只能放 K: An empty column accepts only a K
map.基础堆（Foundation）：同花色、从 A 到 K 升序: Foundation: same suit, ascending A to K
map.废牌堆顶牌可以移到桌面或基础堆: The top waste card can move to the tableau or foundation
map.经典Klondike纸牌接龙游戏，纯前端实现，支持拖拽操作、计时计步、撤销功能。: Classic Klondike Solitaire, pure frontend, with drag-and-drop, timer, move counter and undo. A casual game tool—no install, playable offline.
